assumptions.choice: Split total 10% capital budget equally (5% cash allocation to buy side, 5% to sell side).
assumptions.reason: The specification states that total budget allocated across both sides combined must not exceed 10% of capital, so dividing equally between buy and sell grids satisfies the combined 10% constraint.

assumptions.choice: Cancel all unexecuted active limit orders at the start of each bar in next() before placing new orders.
assumptions.reason: The specification sets Order TTL = 1 bar, meaning unfilled orders expire after 1 bar and grid orders are replenished on the next bar.

assumptions.choice: Scale calculated level volumes proportionally up to meet the 0.1 asset units total side volume minimum if the initial budget calculation yields under 0.1 units.
assumptions.reason: The spec requires total volume per side to be not less than 0.1 units of the asset.

assumptions.choice: Evaluate slippage in notify_order when an order completes as abs(fill_price - limit_price) / limit_price > 0.001. If triggered, set a flag to cancel open orders and skip placing orders on the subsequent bar.
assumptions.reason: This directly enforces the rule to cancel remaining orders and skip the next trading cycle upon a fill price deviation exceeding 0.1%.
